name: Deathwing
summary: Deathwing's shadow still reaches Azeroth's deepest places. Once Neltharion the Earth-Warder, he was the black dragonflight's Dragon Aspect until the Old Gods drove him mad. He turned against the other Aspects and brought fire and turmoil to the world. Defeated near grim batol after the Second War, he is believed slain or hidden away.

sections.title: The Fall of Neltharion
sections.body: The titans gave Neltharion dominion over the earth and Azeroth's subterranean vaults. In those depths, the imprisoned Old Gods whispered to him. During the ancient War of the Ancients, their madness took hold. Neltharion tricked the other Dragon Aspects into placing part of their essence in a golden disc called the Dragon Soul. He said it would stop the Burning Legion, then turned the weapon on his allies and unleashed devastation.

sections.title: Scheme of the Human Lord
sections.body:
After the Second War, Deathwing plotted to bring down mortal kingdoms from within. Taking the human identity of Lord Daval Prestor, a charming noble, he won the favor of King Terenas Menethil II and the high council of the Alliance of Lordaeron.

He aimed to claim Alterac's vacant throne. At grim batol, he also helped the Dragonmaw clan keep Queen Alexstrasza enslaved and harvest her clutches. Rhonin destroyed the Demon Soul and restored the other Aspects' stolen power. They drove Deathwing away.

sections.title: The Brood Left Behind
sections.body: Most mortal kingdoms believe Deathwing was destroyed or driven from the world for good. The black dragonflight remains a scourge across Azeroth, led by his cunning brood, including his daughter Onyxia and son nefarian. Black drakes manipulate mortal politics and terrorize the land from mountain lairs. The scars of the black Aspect's ancient treachery run deep. Travelers crossing craggy wastelands or descending into deep tunnels still fear the Great Dragon may stir.

faq.answer: Deathwing was once Neltharion the Earth-Warder, leader of the black dragonflight. The titans empowered him to shepherd Azeroth's land and mountains. Millennia ago, the deep earth exposed him to the Old Gods' whispers, which eroded his sanity.

The Dragon Soul was a golden artifact Neltharion forged during the War of the Ancients. He tricked the other four Aspects into pouring their power into it, then turned its apocalyptic force against them and mortal defenders. It later became known as the Demon Soul.

Lord Daval Prestor was the human identity Deathwing adopted after the Second War. Using charm magic and courtly deception, he tried to claim Alterac's throne and manipulate the Alliance of Lordaeron from within before his treachery came to light.

faq.q: What is Deathwing's connection to Grim Batol?
faq.answer: At grim batol, Deathwing secretly gave the Dragonmaw orcs the Demon Soul, keeping the red dragon queen Alexstrasza chained and bred for war. Rhonin later destroyed the artifact with one of Deathwing's scales. Restored to their power, the other Aspects fought Deathwing and drove him away.

faq.q: Who leads the black dragonflight today?
faq.answer: With Deathwing absent and presumed dead, his chief descendants act on their own. His daughter Onyxia broods in her lair in dustwallow Marsh, while his son nefarian commands black dragons and experiments with dragonsblood high atop Blackrock Mountain.

angles.text: Alliance nobles still shudder at how close Lord Daval Prestor came to taking Alterac's crown and turning the Council of Seven Nations against the Alliance from within.
The Old Horde made a wicked bargain with Deathwing during the Second War, using the Dragonmaw clan to secure red dragons. The new Horde seeks to leave that stain in the past.

As a Night Elf, you know that Kaldorei elders remember Neltharion's sudden, devastating betrayal ten thousand years ago during the War of the Ancients. The atrocity broke dragonkind and sealed the doom of their ancient empire.
